oneOf.description: ASPRS standard binary LiDAR point‑cloud format storing XYZ, intensity, classification, GPS time, RGB, etc. Industry default.
Lossless compressed version of LAS (LASzip), reducing size by 70–90% while preserving all LiDAR attributes.
Digital Surface Model (highest‑return LiDAR raster surface: includes buildings, vegetation, objects).
Digital Terrain Model (bare‑earth raster derived from classified ground returns). Often interchangeable with DEM.
Raster Digital Elevation Model generated from ground returns; typically distributed as GeoTIFF.
Raster georeferenced TIFF used for storing DEM/DSM/CHM and other LiDAR‑derived surfaces.
Plain‑text XYZ (or XYZI, XYZR) point format for simple exchange and processing workflows.
Non‑proprietary point‑cloud format widely used for LiDAR scanning, photogrammetry, and multi‑sensor point‑cloud interchange.
Cloud‑Optimized Point Cloud (LAZ‑based point‑cloud structure enabling spatially indexed, cloud‑native streaming of very large datasets).
